description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeSubordinateSearchFilterParams class, which extends FilterParams and is used for filtering subordinate employee data in the OrangeHRM system. It primarily manages a single filter parameter, empNumber, and sets a default sort field.

classes.name: EmployeeSubordinateSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) class used to encapsulate filtering parameters for subordinate employee search queries.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with a default sort field 'subordinate.lastName'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the employee number filter parameter.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter parameter.
